mapper.select: SELECT id FROM im_conversation WHERE type = 1 AND participant_a = LEAST(#{userA}, #{userB}) AND participant_b = GREATEST(#{userA}, #{userB}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_conversation (type, participant_a, participant_b, secret_key, create_time) VALUES (1, LEAST(#{userA}, #{userB}), GREATEST(#{userA}, #{userB}), #{secretKey}, NOW())
INSERT INTO im_conversation (type, group_name, group_avatar, owner_id, secret_key, create_time) VALUES (2, #{groupName}, #{groupAvatar}, #{ownerId}, #{secretKey}, NOW())

INSERT INTO im_group_member (conversation_id, user_id, join_time) VALUES
(#{m.conversationId}, #{m.userId}, NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO im_group_member (conversation_id, user_id, join_time) VALUES (#{convId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.type, CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN u.username ELSE c.group_name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.type = 1 THEN u.avatar ELSE c.group_avatar END AS avatar, c.last_msg, c.last_msg_time, c.last_msg_type, 0 AS unread_count FROM im_conversation c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.type = 1 AND u.id = CASE WHEN c.participant_a = #{userId} THEN c.participant_b ELSE c.participant_a END WHERE ( (c.type = 1 AND (c.participant_a = #{userId} OR c.participant_b = #{userId})) OR (c.type = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM im_group_member gm WHERE gm.conversation_id = c.id AND gm.user_id = #{userId} )) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_block b WHERE c.type = 1 AND ( (b.blocker_id = #{userId} AND b.blocked_id = CASE WHEN c.participant_a = #{userId} THEN c.participant_b ELSE c.participant_a END) OR (b.blocked_id = #{userId} AND b.blocker_id = CASE WHEN c.participant_a = #{userId} THEN c.participant_b ELSE c.participant_a END) ) ) ORDER BY c.last_msg_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_read_cursor (conversation_id, user_id, last_read_seq, update_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{lastReadSeq}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_seq = GREATEST(last_read_seq, #{lastReadSeq}), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM im_group_member WHERE conversation_id = #{convId}
SELECT secret_key FROM im_conversation WHERE id = #{convId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND seq > COALESCE( (SELECT last_read_seq FROM im_read_cursor WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId}), 0) AND sender_id != #{userId} AND is_recalled = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unread), 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread FROM im_message m LEFT JOIN im_read_cursor rc ON rc.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND rc.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.is_recalled = 0 AND m.seq > COALESCE(rc.last_read_seq, 0) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_conversation c WHERE c.id = m.conversation_id AND (c.participant_a = #{userId} OR c.participant_b = #{userId})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_group_member gm WHERE gm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND gm.user_id = #{userId}) ) GROUP BY m.conversation_id ) t
